Numerical extrapolation is not used.

value.rationale: A4 has the smallest natural three-dimensional noncommutative Fourier block. The theorem determines exact sharp attainable recovery ranks for every three-point support, distinguishes noncyclic transversals via a rank-10 possibility, identifies the only rank-4 supports, and proves other missing ranks not visible from support cardinality. The classification is a natural complete finite invariant with explicit witnesses, not an arbitrary unmotivated slice or condition-number claim.
